metadata.Name: Japanese GEC Quality Estimation Dataset
metadata.Description: A quality estimation dataset for Japanese Grammatical Error Correction (GEC). It contains source sentences from Japanese learners (from TEC-JL and FLUTEC corpora), corresponding corrected sentences generated by four different GEC systems, and human-annotated scores on a 5-point Likert scale evaluating the quality of the corrections.
metadata.Paper Title: Construction of a Quality Estimation Dataset for Automatic Evaluation of Japanese Grammatical Error Correction
metadata.Venue Title: Proceedings of the Language Resources and Evaluation Conference (LREC 2022)
metadata.Abstract: In grammatical error correction (GEC), automatic evaluation is an important factor for research and development of GEC systems. Previous studies on automatic evaluation have demonstrated that quality estimation models built from datasets with manual evaluation can achieve high performance in automatic evaluation of English GEC without using reference sentences. However, quality estimation models have not yet been studied in Japanese, because there are no datasets for constructing quality estimation models. Therefore, in this study, we created a quality estimation dataset with manual evaluation to build an automatic evaluation model for Japanese GEC. Moreover, we conducted a meta-evaluation to verify the dataset's usefulness in building the Japanese quality estimation model.
